title: When the Promise Falls
author: D. M. Oyelaran
blurb: Ivo Montrose, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the festival ends.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
